name: The Church Family
overview: Scripture reveals the church as a spiritual family united by Christ’s love, where believers are called to love one another deeply and honor each other as brothers and sisters. Jesus Himself redefined family boundaries by identifying His disciples as His true family, emphasizing the new covenant bond among believers. The early church exemplified this family unity through steadfast devotion to teaching, fellowship, prayer, and shared meals. As members of God's household, Christians are urged to do good especially to fellow believers, reflecting the intimate and caring nature of the church family.
